contests.title: M*stertest
contests.rules:
Send your best cards/artifacts! I can't promise the best 3 will get into the game, but I can certainly show them to the people who CAN make that happen, so do your best!

You have until the end of the month, good luck!

parts.name: Become a HERO
parts.desc: Goal: 35. After an ally monster attacks and kills an enemy monster, gain a counter for all excess DMG dealt. Reward: Equip _The Shadow Mantle_.

parts.name: The Shadow Mantle
parts.desc: Turn end: Draw a monster and give it +2/+1. If it cost 6+ G, also give it Darkspawn. Shock: Add a {Friendling} to the enemy deck.

parts.name: Mantle Holder
parts.desc: Haste. Darkspawn. Quest: _Become a HERO_. Magic and Turn start: Add a {Friendling} to the top of the enemy deck.

parts.name: Friendling
parts.desc: Darkspawn. Magic: Draw a card. Dust: If this was killed by an enemy monster, give it Candy.

parts.name: Signery
parts.desc: Magic: Enchant a random empty and unenchanted enemy slot with _Enchantery_.

parts.name: Enchantery
parts.desc:
After a monster is played here, Program (2): Enchant a random empty and unenchanted enemy slot with _Enchantery_ and this effect expires.
Turn end: Deal DMG to you equal to the amount of turns this has been active.

parts.name: Zenith Wing
parts.desc: Haste. Dust: Deal DMG to all enemy monsters equal to the excess DMG this received.

parts.name: Castle Poster
parts.desc: Need: 3+ damaged monsters in the board. Magic: Add 2 {Drafts} to your hand.

parts.name: Jail Handcuff
parts.desc: Magic: Paralyze an enemy monster. Dust: Silence it.
